name: AriseGoServe
shortDescription: A ministry in the Dominican Republic mobilizing leaders to share the gospel and strengthening local communities through service and discipleship.
fullDescription: AriseGoServe orchestrates mission trips into the Dominican Republic. AGS is committed to the mobilization and unification of the Body of Christ with the purpose of equipping and empowering the saints to do the work of the ministry. The ministry is founded upon the establishing of life-long relationships as for engaging in outreach, evangelism, and disciple-making.
